item.text: I’m auditing every log-write call site against the staging contract to ensure no runtime commit path silently bypasses `StageCommitIndex`.

The call-site audit found a missing wrapper capability: `LogCache` forwards `MonotonicLogStore` but not the new `CommitTrackingLogStore`, despite promising to wrap any log store. I’m testing whether enabling committed-log recovery through a cached store incorrectly fails startup.

item.text: Found and reproduced an additional integration defect: `LogCache`, the library’s transparent log-store wrapper, does not forward the new commit-tracking interface, so wrapping a valid tracking store makes `NewRaft` reject the configuration. I’ve added it as Finding 8 and am running the final suite.

# HashiCorp Raft correctness audit

Source identity: `0f543c056e7e577a54b819a62116335c9661a13a`

The implementation's new `RestoreCommittedLogs` startup and persistence paths
have seven independently reproducible correctness defects, plus one independent
defect in the exposed cluster test helper. All occur with supported
configuration values; the configuration-loss defect can prevent a cluster from
electing a leader after a coordinated restart.

Comparison with the cached `hashicorp/raft v1.7.3` source showed that the
relevant semantic additions are the `RestoreCommittedLogs` recovery path and
commit-index staging. The remaining differences reviewed were dependency
compatibility, API-header promotion, and lint-driven changes.

16:## Finding 1: committed-log recovery discards the persisted cluster configuration
155:## Finding 2: startup deadlocks while replaying enough committed batches
253:## Finding 3: recovery moves the public commit index behind restored FSM state
318:## Finding 4: accepting AppendEntries can overwrite a higher persisted commit index
390:## Finding 5: the shipped in-memory tracker violates its staged-index bound
432:## Finding 6: cluster test helper never refreshes its expected configuration
495:## Finding 7: exported live-recovery flag races its commit-staging reader
539:## Finding 8: LogCache drops the commit-tracking capability of its backend

item.text:
Found and reproduced an eighth issue: `LogCache`, the library’s transparent log-store wrapper, does not forward the new `CommitTrackingLogStore` capability. Wrapping a valid commit-tracking backend therefore makes `NewRaft` reject the configuration with `ErrIncompatibleLogStore`.
